# StreamDek Mobile v2.1.21

## What's New

**Video Decoding settings**
Decoding now has a page of its own under Playback. DV7 - HEVC Fallback and Tunneled Playback have
moved off Streams and Quality, and the two mpv compatibility options have moved off Player, so all
four sit together with the mpv ones kept under **If a Video Will Not Play**. These settings
describe this device's hardware rather than your preferences, so they stay on this device instead
of following your account to another one.

## Improvements

**Dolby Vision Profile 7**
Profile 7 titles now keep native Dolby Vision when the device and display actually support it, and
switch to compatible HEVC playback only when they do not, or when decoding fails. The switch
happens at most once per source and no longer treats missing profile information as Profile 7, so
ordinary HEVC and the other Dolby Vision profiles are left alone. Protected titles keep their
existing playback path. **DV7 - HEVC Fallback** is now on by default; a choice you have already
made is kept.

**Less work on the way up**
StreamDek now ships a startup profile, so the code that runs while the app opens is prepared ahead
of time instead of on the day. Launch is a little quicker and frame times through the opening are
steadier, most noticeably on the first launch after an update.

**A loading screen you can see**
The profile picker's loading state now sweeps a band of light across the page. The previous
version faded the whole page between three and eight percent of white over four and a half
seconds, on a screen that is usually gone inside one, so in practice it looked like nothing was
happening at all. Reduced Motion still gets a still screen.

## Fixed

- Fixed choosing a source further down the list, having it drop, and the **first** source playing
  instead. Recovery now carries on from the source you chose rather than starting again at the top
  of a list you had scrolled past.
- Fixed a source that had been playing normally being given up at the first interruption. A
  dropped connection or an expired link is now answered by reopening the same source at your
  position, and another source is only tried if that fails too.
